title: NHK Special — ひきこもり (Social Withdrawal in Japan)
description: NHK Special documentary on hikikomori (ひきこもり) — the phenomenon of severe social withdrawal, in which individuals (estimated at over 1 million in Japan) confine themselves to their home for six months or more. Explores causes including school refusal, workplace pressure, and family dynamics, and follows support workers and families seeking reconnection.
creator: NHK Special (NHKスペシャル)
